notes: One guide, several routes: the registry extracts the PARTNER / SPOUSE route (VISA_SOURCE_OVERRIDES includeSections: overview, partner-spouse, proof-income-partner, knowledge-of-english, provide-information). Expected values are for that route.

Fee rule (#59): outside-UK application fee for joining a partner is £2,064. The IHS is printed as a TOTAL per length (not per year): for an adult staying 2 years and 9 months (the partner visa's length from outside the UK) it is £3,105. Expected as ONE surcharge component of 3105 GBP per application. VERIFIER: confirm this reading (the alternative, 1035 x 3, is not printed on this page).
processingDaysMin: the page only says 'within 12 weeks' (outside the UK), so any minimum from 0 to 84 days is consistent with it.
